# Oryzae

> Oryzae（オリゼー）は、ひとつの「問い」を中心に据えたジャーナリング支援アプリ。日々書いた言葉を AI が「発酵」させ、要約ではなく思考を進めるための手紙と切片を返す。Made by Ephemere.

Oryzae is a journaling companion app centered on a single "question." You set one question you most want to think about, write entries through the week, and on the weekend an AI "ferments" your writing (through three stages modeled on koji mold, lactic-acid bacteria, and yeast) and returns a short letter and excerpts to deepen your thinking — not a summary.

## Key facts

- Maker: Ephemere (https://ephemere.io)
- Languages: Japanese, English, Chinese, Korean
- Writing: vertical writing by default (optimized for Japanese/Chinese), switchable to horizontal; serif/sans fonts
- Privacy: entries and questions are encrypted at rest; only the author and the fermentation process read them; never shared with third parties
- What the AI reads: only your question and the entries you linked to it that week
- Availability: Research Preview (limited capacity), free to use

## Pages

- [Home](https://oryzae.ephemere.io/): product overview, concept, process, FAQ
- [Support](https://oryzae.ephemere.io/support): help and frequently asked questions
- [Privacy Policy](https://oryzae.ephemere.io/privacy): how writing is stored and handled

## Notes

- App pages (login, journal, questions, jar, account) require authentication and are intentionally not indexed.
